Comment: L'énoncé est clair et on comprend rapidement ce qu'on doit faire

Goal
* When you write "ink pad" do you actually mean a "letter stamp"? Refer to the Wikipedia entry for clarification: https://simple.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inkpad

* Please change "each segment" to "each full segment".

* Please mention that the space character does not require any ink.

* Please delete the last sentence, as the final cost should never need rounding; the rounding should already be handled when calculating the number of ink flasks to buy.

Input
* Line 4: Please add "lowercase" before "letters".

* Line 4: Please change [[7_segment_layouts]] to [[layouts]].

Input / Output / Constraints
* Please change "price" to "cost" everywhere.

Output
* Please add ", shown to 2 decimal places" at the end.

Constraints
* All cases currently violate the second constraint. Please fix this.

* Please add:
[[text]] contains lowercase English letters and spaces only.

Stub generator
* Line 2: Please change "P" to "inkPadCost" (or most probably "letterStampCost").

* Line 3: Please change "F" to "inkFlaskCost".

* Line 4: Please change to loopline 26 layout:word(7).

Game modes
* Reverse mode might be too difficult for players to guess the requirement. Please consider disabling it.

Cases
* Please revise your code and change all the case outputs to show 2 decimal places.

* Please add a new pair of cases where all 26 letters are present in [[text]]. Use real words and ensure that some letters appear more than once.

Thanks.

The statement is confusing.

- "Jimmy has to print out a text on paper".
Should be formatted as [[text]].

- "Every letter stamp only contains one letter".
Should mention that there are 26 stamps containing a *layout* for each letter of the alphabet.

- "Every character is printed using the format of a 7 segment display".
Should specify that the characters are from [[text]].

- "One layout of a 7 segment character is defined by a string of characters, f for full and e for empty.".
Reads better as "A layout is a string containing 7 characters consisting of {{f}} for full and {{e}} for empty".

- "Given the layout of 7 segment characters, the text to print, the cost for one letter stamp and the cost for one flask of ink...".
The first item could be simplified to "Given the layouts of all letters from the alphabet". Also, the order of the items are not like the order of inputs.

Thank you for raising the issues. I've substantially rewritten the Goal section, and reformatted the Input section. The original Goal section is reproduced here for reference:

-----
For an art project, Jimmy has to print out a text on paper, using ink and letter stamps.
Every letter stamp only contains one letter and is reusable.
Every character is printed using the format of a 7 segment display, and each full segment needs 1 drop of ink.
The space character doesn't need any ink.
One layout of a 7 segment character is defined by a string of characters, <<f>> for full and <<e>> for empty.
Jimmy can buy flasks of ink, but each flash only contains 7 drops of ink.

Given the layout of 7 segment characters, the text to print, the cost for one letter stamp and the cost for one flask of ink, how much will Jimmy have to pay for his art project ?
-----

Points to note:

* I opt not to format "text" as a variable in the Goal section as the word can be used in its ordinary English meaning.

* I also opt to highlight 26 in the Input section instead of specifying it in the Goal section.

* While you might describe a stamp as containing a layout, it seems more natural to me to link the layout to the segments.

* I opt not to repeat the inputs in the Goal section for simplicity.
